{{Top|leg}}
The '''D-90 assault droid''' was an experimental version of the [[D-60 assault droid]] that was used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The were reputed to be as tough as, yet more versatile, than their predecessor design. The Separatists planned to deploy these [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] in small teams, so that they could serve as [[Commando/Legends|commando]] units, as well as filling the role of battlefield shock troops. However, they still had some system flaws; in order to remedy this, the Separatists planned to capture the [[Spaarti Creations]] factory on [[Cartao/Legends|Cartao]] to test and finalize the design. It was unknown whether their development was continued after Spaarti Creations was destroyed during the [[Attack on Cartao]].<ref name="Gero of Cartao">{{InsiderCite|issue1=68|issue2=70|Hero of Cartao}}</ref>
